description: The lessons registry (D-069 items 4 and 9): lessons from every unit retro, their root-cause class, the change they ask for, their status and measured effect.

lessons.area_path_pattern.description: A backticked path in a retro item; it becomes the lesson area (the files it is about).

lessons.audit_schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of one audit entry.

lessons.audit_suffix.description: File suffix of a lesson's audit trail, next to its record.

lessons.brief_general.description: Whether applied lessons with no area (they apply to every unit) are returned after the area matches.

lessons.brief_limit.description: Most lessons the brief query returns for one area.

lessons.brief_statuses.description: Lesson statuses a launch brief is given; a proposed lesson is not yet a rule.

lessons.by_default.description: Who a trail entry names when the caller gives no --by.

default: check-gap=structure stage,after each commit,per commit,a gate-local test,hook
lessons.class_keywords.description: Class of a retro item: the first entry whose keyword (a lowercase word or phrase, matched at a word start) occurs in the item, as class=keyword,keyword.

lessons.classes.description: Root-cause classes (one vocabulary for retros, the aggregator and the gate). ordering: steps done in the wrong order; process: push, gate or commit discipline; brief: missing or ambiguous brief; env: shell, toolchain or machine; drift: generated or catalogued data out of sync; boundary: ports, ownership, manifests; check-gap: a check existed but ran too late or not at all; api-misuse: an assumed API, id or signature; test-fragility: a test pinned a value or fixture; single-writer: two writers of one artifact.

lessons.default_class.description: Class of a retro item no class keyword matches.

lessons.default_kind.description: Kind of a retro item no kind keyword matches.

lessons.default_level.description: Level of a lesson added without one; one of lessons.levels.

lessons.digest_algorithm.description: Hash of an audit entry; each entry carries the digest of the one before, so an edit or a removed entry breaks the chain.

lessons.effect_stage_fail.description: Stage result that counts as an occurrence when a signal names a gate stage.

lessons.effect_verdicts.description: Verdicts of a measured effect, in the order: fewer, the same, more occurrences after than before, and not enough data.

lessons.effect_window_days.description: Days before and after a lesson was applied that the effect counts. An after-window not yet over, or no occurrence in either window, is insufficient data, never a number.

lessons.genesis_digest.description: The 'previous digest' of the first audit entry.

lessons.id_hash_chars.description: Characters of the dedup hash kept in the id.

lessons.id_prefix.description: Prefix of a lesson id; the rest is the dedup hash of (source unit, reference, title).

lessons.ingest_by.description: Who the trail names for a lesson the ingestion registered.

lessons.ingest_glob.description: Retro files the ingestion reads: one per unit, docs/units/<unit>/retro.md.

lessons.ingest_section.description: Number of the retro section that holds the lessons (the RETRO template: 1 brief, 2 audit and plan, 3 execution, 4 gate, 5 lessons).

lessons.kind_keywords.description: Kind of change of a retro item, same form as lessons.class_keywords; lessons.default_kind when none matches.

lessons.kinds.description: Kinds of concrete change a lesson asks for. A lesson of kind check grows the per-commit check registry.

lessons.levels.description: Levels a lesson applies at, narrow to wide: commit, pr, program or venture. A lesson that applies to every venture is marked padrao_candidate, to be lifted later into the central Padrão in A Torre (not built here).

lessons.list_columns.description: Columns of scripts/lessons list, in order.

lessons.owner_aliases.description: Retro wording for an owner, 'phrase=owner' (lowercase phrase found in the owner text).

lessons.owners.description: Owners a lesson may name; the ingestion normalizes the retro wording (lessons.owner_aliases) to one of these.

lessons.producer.description: Producer name on the events the lessons tool emits.

lessons.record_actions.description: Actions an audit entry may name.

lessons.record_schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of a lesson record.

lessons.record_suffix.description: File suffix of a lesson record.

lessons.register_dir.description: Directory of the lessons registry: one record per lesson, named <slug> plus lessons.record_suffix (D-069 items 4 and 9). No common file (D-064 a).

lessons.report_digest_chars.description: Characters of the report digest carried in the lessons.reported event.

lessons.report_path.description: Where the aggregator writes the generated lessons report.

lessons.report_title.description: Heading of the generated lessons report.

lessons.report_top.description: Classes the report ranks in its summary table before the full list.

lessons.report_unknown_cost.description: Cell shown when a class has no signal, so its cost cannot be measured from the event log.

lessons.retro_comment_title.description: First line of the PR comment that carries a unit retro.

lessons.signal_map.description: Signals a lesson of a class gets when ingested, 'class=event|stage|pattern' (empty stage or pattern is any). A class not listed has no signal and its effect stays insufficient data.

lessons.slug_max_chars.description: Characters of the title kept in the file name.

lessons.statuses.description: The lifecycle, in order: proposed (a retro found it), applied (the change is in the engine), retired (no longer needed).

lessons.title_max_chars.description: Characters of a lesson title taken from the first sentence of its retro item.

lessons.transitions.description: Allowed status changes, 'from>to'. Every other change is refused.

lessons.unknown_owner.description: Owner of a lesson whose retro text names none of lessons.owners.
